youtube_description:
Rookie Missionary Tip 042: Mind the GapMinder. Meet the most in-depth, comprehensive, and interactive data resource on humanitarianism around. Research the founder, Hans Rosling, on TED.com.

Grant and Marissa Nieddu, live from the mission field on the Island of Hispaniola, offer their daily Rookie Missionary Tips and Mistakes. www.RookieMissionary.com.
